A Roman Terra Sigillata (Samian) sherd from the rim and wall of an open ware vessel, probably dating to c. AD 70-230. The wall is slightly curved and the rim is beaded. The sherd was probably once part of a Dragendorff form 37 bowl, probably of East Gaulish fabric.
